requirements_before_use: 1. An abstractor blinded to outcome status must review S23_radiology_review_sample.csv and record a gold-standard call per report. 2. Precision and recall must be estimated, weighted by the recorded sampling fractions (the strata are sampled at different rates, so an unweighted estimate would be wrong). 3. Only findings meeting a pre-specified precision threshold may enter an analysis, and 'not mentioned' must remain a distinct category throughout. 4. Because reports exist for cases only, any resulting variable supports WITHIN-IIH analyses exclusively. It can never be used to compare cases with controls.
